title: 第2章 校花秦嫣然
content_zh:
被林清雪这么一叫，苏林就浑身一抖，本能地站住了，知道被班主任林老师发现了。不过苏林转念一想，上课铃刚刚响过，而现在自己也已经是进入学校里面了，不应该算是迟到，所以还是比较理直气壮地转了过来，看着气势汹汹踏着高跟鞋走过来的林清雪，却又立马怯了，心虚地道了一声：“林老师……”

“苏林，你看看，现在都几点了？上课铃都打过了，老师昨天是怎么跟你说的？让你不要再迟到不要再迟到了，现在离高考就剩下最后一个月了。你看看班上其他的同学，都巴不得五六点就到班级早读，而你却连准时到校都做不到……”

林清雪气呼呼地，两只芊芊玉手插腰，恨铁不成钢地对着苏林发着脾气，“努力付出和收获是成正比的，苏林你成天这么吊儿郎当不学习，成绩怎么可能进步，你再这样下去，连本二的学校都考不上了……”

被班主任老师教训的确是很丢面子，但是也要看看是怎么样的班主任老师了。如果是成天板着脸教训人的老学究，或者是破口大骂的更年期妇女，那真的比较难熬。

可苏林的班主任老师林清雪却是刚刚从师范学校毕业两三年，二十四五岁正是一个女人从青涩彻底迈向成熟的年龄段，而且林清雪为了保持班主任老师的威严，也在着装上故意走成熟路线，都是职业西装衬衫高跟鞋这样的组合。

“其实林老师的身材还是很不错的，凹凸有致，黑色丝袜包着美腿，如果可以摸一下，一定非常的……”

一边被林清雪说着，苏林却还能够一边想入非非，以至于林清雪都已经发现苏林看自己的眼光不对了，立马咳了一声，“苏林，你眼睛到底在看哪里？老师和你说话，你到底有没有认真在听？真的要老师请你的家长来了么？”

“别别别……林老师，我知道错了，我一定……一定用功读书，保证以后一定不会再迟到了。林老师，要上课了……我……我先去教室了……”

像往常的每一次一样，苏林下了一个没有保证的保证以后，就马上撒腿跑向教室了。

真是拿苏林没辙了，林清雪也只好气呼呼地叹了一口气。其实作为高三（2）班的班主任，班级里每一个同学她都尽心尽力地教导帮助，在她看来，苏林虽然现在的成绩不怎么好，也就是考个四百多分，勉强能更上三本，但是苏林并不笨，相反悟性还特别高，就是不够努力，如果再努力努力，兴许能够上二本的院校。

因此，吊车尾成绩的苏林，反而成为了林清雪高考前重点照顾地对象，也不是她成天想找苏林的茬，是真的想要让苏林的成绩更上一层楼。

“林子，你今天怎么又迟到了？没碰到林老师？”

到了班级，看到苏林又这么晚来了，同桌兼死党的李浩一脸幸灾乐祸地说道，“上次林老师不是说了么？你要是再迟到就要叫家长了。”

“呼……运气不够好，又被林老师说了一顿。还好林老师没有让我请家长，不然我妈肯定要扒了我的皮……”

苏林狠狠瞪了李浩一眼，将书包随手塞入抽屉，坐了下来，对李浩说道，“你别说我了，浩子，你也好不到哪里去，马上就要高考了，就我们俩这种成绩，高考以后怎么办？”

看了看同桌薛浩那一身的肥肉，圆滚滚的，苏林就忍不住拍了一下李浩的肚皮，“你看看就你这大肚子，就算是要去东广省打工也没人要。”

“谁要去打工了？我老爹说了，等我高中毕业了，要么就去一些职业中专混几年，不然就直接回家跟他做生意去……打工？那都是给别人赚钱，我才不做那亏本生意呢？倒是林子你，要不你也跟我一起做生意去？”

“我？我……我在看看吧！高考以后再说……”

提到了未来的去向这个问题，苏林就不免也迷茫了一下，自己这半吊水的学习成绩，就算考上大学也是高价的三本学校，家里供不供自己都还是问题，难不成高中毕业以后真的直接去打工么？想到这里，苏林又有一些不甘心。想起初中的时候，苏林还是一个优等生，要不然也不会考上这建安一中了。

只是因为高中三年懈怠了，所以苏林的成绩才一直这么半死不活的。

环顾了一下班级，苏林发现除了自己和李浩，其他的同学都在用功早读，要么是背英语单词，要么是在背诵古诗词。目光扫了一下，苏林看了看班级里成绩最好的那几个同学，他们都是基本上百分百能够考上一本重点大学的，心里面也不禁羡慕嫉妒了一番。苏林知道，高考过后，自己和他们的命运就会有天翻地覆地差别了。

日子得过且过，高考以后能怎么样，苏林每次想起来也是一阵的心烦。爸妈也已经老了，家里的经济情况也不好，对于未来，苏林真的是迷茫了。

“喂！苏林……交昨天的英语作文，你们一组的小组长把别人的都收上来了，你今天又迟到，全班就差你的了，赶紧交，我好抱到办公室给林老师批改。”

走到苏林跟前抱着一堆作文本的正是高三（2）班的班长兼班花秦嫣然，因为秦嫣然还是英语课代表，负责收英文作业，所以这才跑到苏林的面前来催作业的。

其实秦嫣然不仅是高三（2）班的班花，更是整个建安一中的校花，甜美的外表，优异的成绩，让她既是老师们的掌中宝，又是全校男生的梦中女神。今天的秦嫣然穿着一套淡白色地小布裙，白色的丝袜连到脚底，踩着一双可爱的小花布鞋，乌黑的秀发扎成一束马尾，摇头轻轻一甩，空气里顿时多了一股好闻的淡淡发香。

“啊？英语作文？我……不好意思，班长大人，我……我又忘记做了，能不能……晚一点再交啊！我马上补，就十分钟，十分钟行不行？第一节上课前我一定交给你。”

苏林一拍脑袋，自己这记性，居然又忘记做作业了，只好向秦嫣然求情道。

“林子，你的这个办法太老套了。想要靠不做英语作业的办法来吸引我们班花的注意，是注定要失败的。因为哥已经试过无数遍了，这只能换回去林老师办公室喝茶的机会。”

同桌李浩却是在一边嬉皮笑脸，眼睛不时地偷看秦嫣然几眼，毕竟这可是全校男生心目中的女神，可是也没见谁得到过秦嫣然的一丝亲睐过。

“死浩子，你就别瞎捣乱了。班长大人，我马上做，马上做……千万不要告诉林老师，不然我就死定了……”

早上迟到就已经被林老师训了一顿，如果一会儿让林老师知道自己又没有做英语作业，恐怕林老师马上就会一个电话打到苏林家，把苏林的父母给叫来了。

“那我就再等你十分钟，苏林，你快点。”

秦嫣然只是淡淡说了一句，然后就抱着作业本转身回到自己的座位上继续看书了。就是这样冷冰冰的，秦嫣然几乎对任何的男生都是这个态度，不管男生为了追求她做了什么，她都一点不为所动，也不会和任何男生多说哪怕一句话。

“看吧！林子，我都说了这个法子不管用了，想要追求校花？在我们建安一种来说就是一个笑话。”

“滚吧！死浩子，我是真忘记做作业了，快告诉我，昨天英语作文题目要求是什么？”

“你真没做啊？那还不赶紧……昨天的英语作文题目是假定你是李华，希望通过外籍教师Peter找一个英语笔友。请写一封短信，描述一下你理想中笔友的条件，并说明为什么选这样的笔友……”

“怎么又是李华？这李华也真够忙的……”

听到这个英语作文的题目，苏林就是一阵的头疼，可是头疼也得写呀！只好一边翻单词本找单词寻句型，一边磕磕碰碰地，总算是在十分钟左右时间，将一篇十句话只通了一两句的蹩脚英语作文给凑出来了。

“哎……林子，你说我们班的男生真的是空守着宝山，占据天时地利，却无法近水楼台先得月。放着班长大人这么一个大美女无可奈何啊……”

李浩望着座位前方秦嫣然的座位，叹息了一声，还真有一种望洋兴叹的意味。别看他成绩也不好，但是却是能说会道，说起来都是一套一套的。

而苏林听到李浩的话，回顾了一下三年的高中时光，貌似还真是这样的。虽然说秦嫣然三年来一直担任班级的班长，学校的各项活动也都积极参加，接触的男生可以说是普通女生的两到三倍，更不用说学校里那些慕名前来表白的男生了。

可就是这么多的男生，秦嫣然居然没有一个看得上眼，不说喜欢，就连正眼看的都没有一个，因此秦嫣然也有了“冰美人”的校花称号。

“就不说我们班了，其他班的，在学校里面的风云人物。比如篮球队的罗天，还有小霸王彭深达，哪一个对我们班长大人没有意思？但是却没有一个得手的，你瞅瞅我们班长大人的小手，还有那酥胸，要是能够摸那么一下，啧啧啧……让我高考少考十分我都愿意……”

李浩继续自己意淫地说着，苏林却是被他逗乐了：“我看你高考多考十分和少考十分没什么差别吧？”

虽然嘴上是这么说，但是顺着李浩的目光看过去，苏林也根本无法将自己的目光从秦嫣然的身上挪开。那清丽脱俗的身影，由于现在秦嫣然是在早读英语，随着一个单词一个单词从她嘴里蹦出来，那上下起伏的胸脯，让苏林看着心跳加快，全身的血液都有些沸腾起来。

“十分钟到了，苏林你的英语作文写完了么？如果还没有写完，我可不等你了。”

十分钟的时间一到，秦嫣然可就掐准了又走了下来，胸前抱着一叠地英语作文本，说道。

因为苏林刚刚一直盯着秦嫣然胸前看，直到秦嫣然走到了自己的面前，所以现在有些心虚地低着头，站了起来，将自己的作文本递了过去。

不过，在秦嫣然接过作文本的一瞬间，苏林想起了今天早上在校门口时间被自己暂停的神奇现象，于是在心里面试探性地叫了一声：“时间……暂停！”

一个激灵，苏林立刻就发现，和刚刚在校门口的状况一样，整个教室内的时间，都被自己暂停了，除了自己以外，其他人都静止了，一动不动。
content_en:
After being called out by Lin Qingxue, Su Lin trembled all over and instinctively stood still, knowing that his head teacher, Teacher Lin, had discovered him.However, Su Lin thought about it. The school bell had just rang, and now he had already entered the school. He should not be considered late, so he turned around more confidently and looked at Lin Qingxue, who was walking aggressively in high heels. However, he immediately became timid and said with a guilty conscience: "Teacher Lin..."

"Su Lin, look, what time is it now? The school bell has rang. What did the teacher tell you yesterday? He told you not to be late again. There is only one month left before the college entrance examination. Look at the other students in the class. They all want to go to class at five or six o'clock to study early, but you can't even get to school on time..."

Lin Qingxue was angrily, with her hands on her waist, and she was angry at Su Lin. "Efforts and rewards are directly proportional. Su Lin, you are so lazy all day long that you don't study. How can your grades improve? If you continue like this, you won't even be able to pass the second grade school..."

It is indeed embarrassing to be scolded by the head teacher, but you also have to look at what kind of teacher you are.If you are an old scholar who lectures others with a straight face all day long, or a menopausal woman who curses, it will be really difficult.

But Su Lin's head teacher, Lin Qingxue, had just graduated from a normal school two or three years ago. The age of twenty-four or five is the age when a woman completely moves from youthfulness to maturity. In order to maintain the majesty of the head teacher, Lin Qingxue also deliberately followed a mature line in dressing, wearing a combination of professional suits, shirts, and high heels.

"Actually, Teacher Lin has a very good figure, with regular bumps and curves, and her beautiful legs are wrapped in black stockings. If you can touch it, she must be very..."

While Lin Qingxue was talking, Su Lin was still able to have wild thoughts, so much so that Lin Qingxue realized that Su Lin was looking at her wrongly, and immediately coughed, "Su Lin, where are your eyes looking at? Are you listening carefully when the teacher is talking to you? Do you really want the teacher to invite your parents?"

"No, no, no... Teacher Lin, I know I was wrong. I will... study hard and promise not to be late again. Teacher Lin, class is about to start... I... I will go to the classroom first..."

Like every time, Su Lin immediately ran to the classroom after making an unguaranteed promise.

There was really nothing to do with Su Lin, so Lin Qingxue could only sigh angrily.In fact, as the head teacher of Class 2 of Senior High School, she tried her best to teach and help every student in the class. In her opinion, although Su Lin's current grades are not very good, that is, he scored more than 400 points in the exam and could barely get into a third-level school, Su Lin is not stupid.

Therefore, Su Lin, who had poor grades, became the focus of Lin Qingxue's care before the college entrance examination. She was not trying to find trouble with Su Lin all day long, but she really wanted to improve Su Lin's grades.

"Lin Zi, why are you late again today? Didn't you meet Teacher Lin?"

When I arrived at class, I saw Su Lin coming so late again. My deskmate and best friend Li Hao said with a gloating look, "Didn't Teacher Lin say what I said last time? If you are late again, you will call your parents."

"Huh... I wasn't lucky enough. I got scolded by Teacher Lin again. Fortunately, Teacher Lin didn't ask me to invite my parents, otherwise my mother would definitely skin me..."

Su Lin glared at Li Hao fiercely, stuffed his schoolbag into the drawer, sat down, and said to Li Hao, "Don't talk about me, Haozi, you are not much better. The college entrance examination is about to take place. With the results we two have, what will happen after the college entrance examination?"

Looking at his deskmate Xue Hao's fat body, Su Lin couldn't help but pat Li Hao's belly, "Look at your big belly, no one wants to work in Dongguang Province."

"Who is going to work? My dad said that after I graduate from high school, I will either go to some vocational technical secondary school to hang out for a few years, or I will just go home and do business with him... to work? That is all about making money for others, and I don't want to do that kind of loss-making business? Lin Zi, how about you do business with me?"

"Me? I... I'll take a look! We'll talk about it after the college entrance examination..."

When the question of his future destination was mentioned, Su Lin couldn't help but feel confused. With his half-assed academic performance, even if he was admitted to a college, it would still be a high-priced school. Whether his family could support him or not was still a problem. Is it possible that he would really go to work directly after graduating from high school?Thinking of this, Su Lin felt a little unwilling.I remember that when he was in junior high school, Su Lin was still a top student, otherwise he would not have been admitted to Jian'an No. 1 Middle School.

It's just because he slacked off during the three years of high school that Su Lin's grades have always been so bad.

Looking around the class, Su Lin found that except for himself and Li Hao, the other students were studying hard for morning reading, either memorizing English words or reciting ancient poems.With a quick glance, Su Lin looked at the students with the best grades in the class. They were all basically 100% able to get into a key university, and he couldn't help but feel envious in his heart.Su Lin knew that after passing the college entrance examination, his destiny and theirs would be completely different.

Life was passing by, and what would happen after the college entrance examination? Sulin felt upset every time he thought about it.His parents were old, and the family's financial situation was not good. Sulin was really confused about the future.

"Hey! Su Lin... handed in yesterday's English composition. The team leader of your group collected everyone else's essays. You are late again today, and the whole class is missing yours. Hand it in quickly, so I can take it to the office for Teacher Lin to correct."

The person who walked up to Su Lin and held a pile of composition papers was Qin Yanran, the squad leader and class beauty of Class 2, Senior High School. Because Qin Yanran was still the English class representative and was responsible for collecting English homework, she came to Su Lin to ask for homework.

In fact, Qin Yanran is not only the class beauty of Grade 3 (2), but also the school beauty of the entire Jian'an No. 1 Middle School. Her sweet appearance and excellent grades make her the darling of the teachers and the dream goddess of all the boys in the school.Today, Qin Yanran was wearing a small pale white dress, white stockings that reached to the soles of her feet, and a pair of cute little flowered cloth shoes. Her black hair was tied into a ponytail. She shook her head slightly, and a nice light hair fragrance suddenly filled the air.

"Ah? English composition? I... I'm sorry, monitor, I... I forgot to do it again, can you... hand it in later! I'll make it up right away, just ten minutes, okay? I'll give it to you before the first period of class."

Su Lin slapped his head. He had such a bad memory that he actually forgot to do his homework again, so he had to plead with Qin Yanran.

"Lin Zi, your method is too old-fashioned. Trying to attract the attention of our class beauty by not doing English homework is doomed to failure. Because I have tried it countless times, and this can only be exchanged for the opportunity to go back to Teacher Lin's office for tea."

Li Hao, the classmate at the same table, was smiling playfully and peeking at Qin Yanran from time to time. After all, she was the goddess in the eyes of all the boys in the school, but no one had ever received a single kiss from Qin Yanran.

"Shi Haozi, please stop making trouble. Mr. Monitor, I'll do it right away, I'll do it right away... Don't tell Teacher Lin, or I'll be dead..."

I was already scolded by Teacher Lin for being late in the morning. If Teacher Lin knew that I had not done my English homework, Teacher Lin would probably call Su Lin's house and call Su Lin's parents.

"Then I'll wait for you for another ten minutes, Su Lin, hurry up."

Qin Yanran just said something lightly, then turned around and returned to her seat with her homework book in her arms to continue reading.Qin Yanran was so cold and cold towards almost all boys. No matter what the boys did to pursue her, she remained unmoved and would not say even a single word to any boy.

"Look! Lin Zi, I already told you that this method won't work. You want to pursue the school beauty? It's a joke in our Jian'an community."

"Go away! Damn Haozi, I really forgot to do my homework. Tell me, what was the requirement for yesterday's English composition topic?"

"You really haven't done it? Why don't you hurry up... Yesterday's English composition topic is assuming that you are Li Hua and hope to find an English pen pal through the foreign teacher Peter. Please write a short message describing the conditions of your ideal pen pal and explain why you choose such a pen pal..."

"Why is it Li Hua again? This Li Hua is really busy..."

Hearing the title of this English composition, Su Lin had a headache, but he had to write even if he had a headache!I had no choice but to flip through the vocabulary book to find words and sentence patterns, and finally, in about ten minutes, I pieced together a poor English composition with only one or two sentences in ten sentences.

"Hey...Lin Zi, you said that the boys in our class are really guarding the treasure mountain for nothing, occupying the right time and place, but they can't get the moon first. There is nothing you can do if you leave such a beautiful girl like the monitor..."

Li Hao looked at Qin Yanran's seat in front of the seat and sighed, with a feeling of despair.Even though his grades are not good, he is very eloquent and knows exactly what he says.

When Su Lin heard Li Hao's words, he looked back on his three years of high school, and it seemed that this was really the case.Although Qin Yanran has been the monitor of the class for three years and actively participates in various school activities, she has contact with two to three times as many boys as ordinary girls, not to mention those boys in the school who come to confess their love.

But there are so many boys, but Qin Yanran doesn't like any of them, not even like them, not even look at them, so Qin Yanran also has the title of "Ice Beauty".

"Let's not talk about our class. The other classes are influential figures in the school. For example, Luo Tian of the basketball team, and the little bully Peng Shenda. Which one is not interesting to our class leader? But none of them can succeed. Take a look at our class leader's small hands and breasts. If you can touch them, tsk tsk tsk... I will give me a ten-point score in the college entrance examination..."

Li Hao continued to talk lustfully, but Su Lin was amused by him: "I think there is no difference between you getting ten points more in the college entrance examination and ten ten points less in your college entrance examination, right?"

Although he said so, following Li Hao's gaze, Su Lin couldn't take his eyes away from Qin Yanran.That elegant and refined figure, because Qin Yanran was reading English early in the morning, word after word came out of her mouth, and the ups and downs of her chest made Su Lin's heartbeat quicken and the blood in his body boil.

"Ten minutes are up. Su Lin, have you finished writing your English composition? If you haven't finished it yet, I won't wait for you."

As soon as the ten minutes were up, Qin Yanran took it right and walked down, holding a stack of English composition texts on her chest and said.

Because Su Lin had just been staring at Qin Yanran's chest until Qin Yanran walked in front of him, so now he lowered his head with a guilty conscience, stood up, and handed over his composition copy.

However, the moment Qin Yanran took over the composition, Su Lin remembered the magical phenomenon that time was suspended by him at the school gate this morning, so he tentatively called out in his heart: "Time...pause!"

With a start, Su Lin immediately discovered that, just like the situation at the school gate, the time in the entire classroom had been suspended by him. Except for himself, everyone else was still and motionless.
